purpose: Track a simulated 1,000 MXN bankroll using three cross-event three-leg parlays per historical jornada without fabricating unavailable historical prices.
capital_rule: No external deposits. Weekly stakes come from the existing simulated bankroll. If bankroll is insufficient, stake sizing must be reduced under a separately versioned rule; no capital is added silently.
why_not_j1_j10: Three 3-leg parlays were not frozen prospectively for every earlier jornada. Creating extra tickets now would be hindsight. J1-J10 retain their original experimental formats and do not enter this clean economic series.
selection_rule: Selections must be frozen before target-jornada outcomes are consumed. From J12 onward, MODEL_ONLY candidate pool plus temporally clean statistical/context audit is frozen first. Prices may then be attached mechanically; no post-price or post-result substitution is allowed unless a replacement rule was preregistered before source retrieval.
odds_cutoff_rule: Every proxy input must have been publicly available before the ticket's earliest-leg kickoff. For maximum replay integrity the preferred source snapshot is at or before the jornada global context cutoff. Later closing prices cannot be used for a ticket that already had an earlier leg live.

primary_pricing_method.name: MARKET_PROXY_V1_1X2_POISSON_SOURCE_OVERROUND
primary_pricing_method.inputs: Archived pre-cutoff 1X2 decimal odds only. p_model is never used to create price.
steps: For score-derived non-1X2 markets, fit independent-Poisson home/away lambdas to the de-vigged 1X2 probabilities.
Derive the target market probability from the fitted score distribution; DOUBLE_CHANCE_12 is derived directly as 1 - p_draw.
Reapply that same overround proportionally to the derived target market probability and invert to decimal odds.
primary_pricing_method.claim_boundary: proxy_decimal is a standardized historical market proxy, NOT an assertion of the exact Caliente or bookmaker price for that derived market.

exact_odds_audit: When a temporally valid exact target-market quote exists, store it separately as CALIENTE_EXACT, BOOK_EXACT or MARKET_CONSENSUS and compare it against the proxy. Never overwrite the standardized proxy series retroactively.
ticket_price: Product of the three proxy decimal leg prices for cross-event parlays.
settlement: Winning ticket return = stake * ticket_decimal. Losing ticket return = 0. Net weekly bankroll = opening bankroll - all stakes + returns.

two_economic_views.FORCED_200_TRACK: Primary user-requested experiment: stake 80/80/40 every historical jornada even when calculated EV is <= 0, provided the bankroll permits.
two_economic_views.EV_DISCIPLINED_COUNTERFACTUAL: Diagnostic comparator: hold cash on tickets whose frozen model probability does not exceed break-even after proxy pricing. This comparator must never replace the forced track.

learning_rule: Outcome does not determine whether a decision was good. Track frozen p_model, proxy break-even, EV, Brier/log loss, market-family residuals and context/statistical candidate features. Model or feature changes require repeated out-of-sample evidence and a new prospective version; never retune because one ticket won or lost.
governance: Append-only. Preserve raw source odds, timestamp/publication date, source tier, transformations, proxy price, exact-price audit if available, ticket result and bankroll state.
